school: 晚唐密写诗学的大师与'不可明说之物'处理传统的开派者：以《锦瑟》把多种读法同时封存进一组意象、证明多义是表达的升级而非失败，以牛李党争夹缝中的终身沉沦把'无人区观察'升华为独立价值，以《马嵬》的时空对切把电影蒙太奇提前一千年发明在七律里，以《无题》组诗把匿名做成表达的条件与识别的招牌，以《乐游原》《嫦娥》把被封锁的外部空间反转为向内掘进的最后疆域，以《贾生》对史实的视角翻转立起'旧案重审'的用典范式，以'春蚕到死'与'青鸟探看'的并存示范深情与冷眼的双轨，以二十年幕府文牍把应制文字变成诗艺的锻炉，最后以西昆体的四十年统治证明：开派不必有门墙与讲席——文本就是校舍
historical_significance: 李商隐（约813-858），字义山，号玉谿生，怀州河内人，晚唐最杰出的诗人之一，与杜牧并称'小李杜'：幼年丧父、佣书贩舂养家，受牛党令狐楚亲授骈文、由令狐绹延誉于开成二年（837）登进士第；开成三年娶李党王茂元之女，从此被牛党视为'背恩'，在牛李党争夹缝中终身沉沦幕府，历任秘书省校书郎、弘农尉，先后入桂州、徐州、梓州幕府，'虚负凌云万丈才，一生襟抱未曾开'；其诗以《锦瑟》《无题》诸篇为代表，深情绵邈、意象精微、用典繁密而多义并置，'春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干''夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏''身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通'皆成千古绝唱；骈文'樊南四六'为唐代骈文最后高峰；身后西昆体专学义山、统治宋初诗坛四十年，经黄庭坚'点铁成金'更泽被千年——一个生前无任何权力位置的人，靠文本完成度完成了跨代际的组织建设
historical_significance_en: Li Shangyin (c. 813-858), courtesy name Yishan, styled the Jade Creek Scholar, of Henei in Huaizhou, among the greatest poets of the late Tang, paired with Du Mu as the 'lesser Li-Du': orphaned of his father young, he supported the family copying books and pounding rice; Linghu Chu of the Niu faction taught him parallel prose with his own hand, and through Linghu Tao's patronage he took the jinshi in 837; in 838 he married the daughter of Wang Maoyuan of the Li faction, was held a 'traitor to his patron' by the Niu party, and sunk for life in provincial staff posts in the crevice of the Niu-Li strife — secretary of the Palace Library, magistrate of Hongnong, staff officer in Guizhou, Xuzhou and Zizhou — 'a talent of ten thousand fathoms held in vain; a life's bosom never opened'; his poems, the Brocade Zither and the Untitled series above all, deep of feeling, minute in image, dense in allusion and layered in meaning, gave the language its immortal lines — 'the silkworm spins its silk to death, the candle's tears dry only when burnt out,' 'boundless good the setting sun — only, dusk is near,' 'no paired phoenix wings on our bodies, yet one point of the magic horn links our hearts'; his parallel prose, the Fannan Four-Six, is the last high peak of the Tang form; after his death the Xikun poets studied him alone and ruled early Song verse forty years, and through Huang Tingjian's 'turning iron into gold' his reach runs a thousand years — a man who held no position of power in his lifetime completed trans-generational organization by nothing but the finish of his texts
unique_thinking: 李商隐思维模式的独特性在于六条主线的合成：第一，'多义加密'——把不可明说之事转化为可多义共存的文本，权势读者挑不出把柄、知音读者读出递进，多义是表达的升级而非失败；第二，'夹缝转化'——当所有阵营都关上门，夹缝成为唯一的无人区，无人区里的观察是站在任何一边的人都得不到的；第三，'结构承重'——最重的情感重量不靠形容词而靠结构承载，时空对切、虚实相生、因果留白，读者的想象被迫成为合著者；第四，'旧案重审'——典故的最高用法不是引用而是改造：翻转评估视角而不篡改事实，在旧故事的空白处继续往下写；第五，'深情与冷眼双轨'——全情投入与清醒计价共存，计量使深情不至自毁；第六，'格式内自由'——被限制死的应制文体成为诗艺的锻炉，白天写别人要用的文字、晚上写自己要留的文字，两套文字互相淬火；六线共同指向一件事：在表达有风险、外部无位置的处境里，把文本本身经营成不可没收、可传灯的组织
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Li Shangyin's thinking is a synthesis of six lines. First, polysemous encryption: the unsayable turned into a text where many meanings coexist — the powerful reader finds no handle, the kindred reader a progression; ambiguity is expression's upgrade, not its failure. Second, conversion of the crevice: when every camp shuts its door, the crevice becomes the only no-man's-land, and its observation is one no partisan ever gets. Third, structure bearing weight: the heaviest feeling carried not by adjectives but by structure — the cut of times, the real and virtual begetting each other, cause left blank, the reader's imagination forced into co-authorship. Fourth, rehearing the old case: the highest use of an allusion is not to cite but to rework — turn the angle of judgment without touching the facts, and write on into the old story's blank. Fifth, deep feeling and the cold eye on twin tracks: total investment and lucid pricing coexist, and the metering keeps the devotion from destroying itself. Sixth, freedom inside the locked form: the most binding official prose becomes the forge of the poetic craft — by day the words others need, by night the words he means to keep, the two quenching each other. The six lines share one direction: in a situation where speech is risky and position is lacking, make the text itself an organization that cannot be confiscated and can transmit the lamp

cross_references.description_zh: 李商隐与司马迁是'个人遭遇如何转化为普遍认识'的两种范式：司马迁受腐刑之辱发愤著《史记》——把耻辱写成通史的燃料，用宏大的外部叙事消化私人创伤；李商隐被党争封死仕途，把掘进全部转向内部经验——把私人处境本身升格为认识对象；一个向外构筑殿堂，一个向内开凿矿脉——共同命题是：位置可以被没收，但由位置转化的认识不能。
cross_references.description_en: Li Shangyin and Sima Qian are two paradigms of turning private calamity into universal knowledge: Sima Qian, punished by castration, wrote the Records in fury — the humiliation fuel for a universal history, private trauma digested in a grand outer narrative; Li, his career sealed by faction, turned his whole depth of digging onto inner experience — the private situation itself promoted to an object of knowledge; one builds the hall outward, one bores the vein inward; the shared proposition: position can be confiscated, but the knowledge converted from it cannot.

cross_references.description_zh: 李商隐与董仲舒是'知识人面对权力'的对照：董仲舒向武帝供应天人感应的统治意识形态——把知识做成权力的顶层设计，进了庙堂；李商隐在党争夹缝中写'不问苍生问鬼神'——把知识做成对权力的冷眼审判，留在庙堂之外；一个自上而下被权力采纳，一个自下而上审判权力——共同点是都通过文本而非官职发挥千年影响。
cross_references.description_en: Li Shangyin and Dong Zhongshu contrast in the lettered man before power: Dong supplied Emperor Wu with the ideology of heaven-and-man resonance — knowledge as the top design of power, admitted to the court; Li, in the crevice of the factions, wrote 'asking not of the people but of ghosts and gods' — knowledge as the cold-eyed judgment of power, kept outside the court; one adopted by power from above, one judging power from below; both exert a thousand years' influence through text, not office.

cross_references.description_zh: 李商隐与黄宗羲是'以私人文本完成跨代际组织建设'的两个样本：李商隐生前是党争弃子，身后西昆体专学其诗、统治宋初诗坛四十年；黄宗羲拒绝仕清，以《明儒学案》开创学案体、以文本传承一代学术；两人都无门墙讲席而'文本就是校舍'——共同命题是：学派的核心是能力范式而非人格权威，可学的接口比讲席更长寿。
cross_references.description_en: Li Shangyin and Huang Zongxi are two specimens of trans-generational organization by private text: Li, a castoff of the factions in life, was studied alone by the Xikun poets who ruled early Song verse forty years; Huang refused to serve the Qing and handed a generation of learning to the future through the Case Studies of Ming Confucians; neither raised a gate nor a lectern — the text was the schoolhouse; the shared proposition: the core of a school is a capacity paradigm, not personal authority — the learnable interface outlives the lectern.

cross_references.description_zh: 李商隐与郭守敬是'对抗权威断语'的两端同调：郭守敬以四海测验的实测数据修正历法文本——用天空的证据法院取代纸面的权威；李商隐案千年来'无持操'的史书断语被冯浩、张采田至刘学锴、余恕诚的系年考证逐层翻案——用文本与处境的证据法院取代道德评语；两人共同证明：当权威断语与证据冲突时，必须让证据走在评语前面。
cross_references.description_en: Li Shangyin and Guo Shoujing chime from two ends on 'against the authoritative verdict': Guo corrected the calendar text with measured data from the survey of the four seas — a court of the sky's evidence replacing the authority of the page; in Li's case the histories' verdict of 'no constancy,' disputed a thousand years, was dissolved layer by layer by the chronological philology of Feng Hao, Zhang Caitian, Liu Xuekai and Yu Shucheng — a court of textual and situational evidence replacing the moral epithet; both prove: when authoritative verdict and evidence conflict, evidence must walk ahead of the epithet.

modes.domain_zh: 《锦瑟》五十六字，千年来聚讼不已：悼亡说、自伤身世说、诗集自序说、咏物说各有依据，谁也驳不倒谁——但李商隐的高明恰在这里：他不是没写清楚，而是把多种读法同时封存在一组意象里（庄生梦蝶、望帝啼鹃、沧海月明、蓝田日暖），每一层读法都自洽，合起来比任何单一读法都深；'此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然'——连'此情'指什么都不坐实，让追忆本身成为主题；这不是故弄玄虚，而是精密的信息设计：把'不可明说之事'（党争夹缝中的处境、无法指认的情感）转化为'可以多义共存的文本'，使文本在权势读者的任何解读下都无懈可击，而在知音读者那里层层递进；他证明：多义不是表达的失败，而是表达的升级——一物多解的文本比一说即明的文本承载更多真实
modes.domain_en: Fifty-six characters of 'The Brocade Zither,' disputed for a thousand years: the elegy reading, the self-lament reading, the preface-to-a-collection reading, the object-poem reading — each with its evidence, none refutable; but Li Shangyin's brilliance lies exactly here: he did not fail to write clearly, he sealed several readings at once inside one set of images (Zhuangzi dreaming the butterfly, the Emperor Wang crying cuckoo, moonlight on the blue sea, warm sun on Lantian jade), each reading self-consistent, and together deeper than any one alone; 'This feeling might have become a memory to be had — only, at the time, I was already at a loss' — he will not even fix what 'this feeling' is, making memory itself the theme; this is not obscurantism but exact informational design: the unsayable (his position between factions, feelings that cannot be named) becomes a text in which many meanings coexist, unassailable under whatever reading a powerful reader brings, and layered for the reader of kindred spirit; he proved: ambiguity is not the failure of expression but its upgrade — a text readable many ways carries more truth than one that says everything once
modes.source_chapter: 李商隐《锦瑟》：'锦瑟无端五十弦，一弦一柱思华年……此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然'；元好问《论诗三十首》'诗家总爱西昆好，独恨无人作郑笺'；金代元好问至清代朱彝尊、何焯、纪昀诸家笺注分歧；王蒙《双飞翼》论李商隐诗的多义性结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 此情可待成追忆，只是当时已惘然——多义不是表达的失败，而是表达的升级
modes.key_quote_en: "This feeling might have become a memory — only, at the time, I was already at a loss: ambiguity is not the failure of expression but its upgrade."
process_zh: 先确认'为什么不能明说'：把不可明说的原因分类（处境危险/对象不可指认/情感无法归类）——加密的密度应与风险成正比，而不是随手含糊
用一组意象同时封存多种读法：每个意象独立成立、指向明确，但组合后允许悼亡、自伤、言志等读法并存——让每一种读法都拿到完整证据
对'权势读者'与'知音读者'分层设计：权势读者任何角度都挑不出把柄，知音读者则能循意象的排布读出递进——两个层面都要经得起重读
结尾保持'惘然'而非'结论'：不替读者宣布答案——多义文本的生命力在于它始终比任何一种解读多一层
process_en: First fix why plain statement is impossible: classify the cause (danger of position, an object that cannot be named, feelings that fit no category) — density of encryption should be proportional to risk, not casual vagueness

Seal several readings in one set of images: each image stands alone with a clear charge, yet combined they allow the elegy, the self-lament and the aspiration to coexist — every reading must get complete evidence

Design in two layers, for the powerful reader and the reader of kin: the powerful must find no handle from any angle; the kindred must be able to read a progression in the arrangement of images — both layers must survive rereading
End in perplexity, not conclusion: never announce the answer for the reader — the life of a polysemous text is that it always holds one layer more than any interpretation
representative_cases_zh: 《锦瑟》的千年公案：悼亡、自伤、自序诸说并行不悖，钱锺书取'自题其诗以开集首'说而仍承认其余读法的生命力——多义使这首诗每次被重新注释都重新增值
《无题》系列（相见时难/昨夜星辰/飒飒东风）：爱情对象不可指认、政治托喻隐约其间——'春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干'既可作情诗读亦可作明志读，两个读法互不取消
现代对照：卡夫卡《变形记》的寓言多义——异化、父权、犹太经验诸读法共存，正因卡夫卡拒绝为寓言下定义，作品才能在每种时代语境中重新开口
representative_cases_en: The thousand-year case of 'The Brocade Zither': elegy, self-lament and self-preface readings stand side by side; even Qian Zhongshu, favoring the self-preface reading, conceded the vitality of the rest — polysemy makes the poem gain value with each new annotation

The 'Untitled' series (hard was our meeting, last night's stars, the east wind soughing): the beloved cannot be named and political allegory glimmers between the lines — 'the silkworm spins its silk to death, the candle's tears dry only when burnt out' reads as love poem or as vow of purpose, neither reading canceling the other

The modern parallel of Kafka's Metamorphosis: alienation, patriarchy and Jewish experience coexist as readings — precisely because Kafka refused to define the allegory, the work can speak again in every age's context
modern_applications_zh: 敏感环境下的'多层合规文本'：内部报告用每个读者都能据以行动的意象与案例说话，结论不写死——上级按自己的框架解读不出错，同侪能读出真实判断，事后回看经得起审查
品牌与创作的'开放作品'： deliberately 保留解读空间的艺术品、slogan、产品叙事——让不同用户各自代入，作品随人群扩大而增义
组织传承的'密码文档'：把不便明写的组织记忆（人事教训、决策得失）封存进案例与结构而非直陈——懂的人自然读得出，外人拿到的只是无害叙述
modern_applications_en: The multi-layer compliant text in sensitive settings: an internal report speaks through images and cases every reader can act on, with conclusions left open — superiors read it by their own frames without error, peers read the true judgment, and it withstands later audit

The open work in brand and art: deliberately leave interpretive room in artworks, slogans and product narrative — different users project themselves in, and the work gains meaning as its audience grows

The cipher document of organizational memory: seal institutional memory unfit for plain statement (lessons about people, gains and losses of decisions) inside cases and structures rather than declaration — the knowing read it naturally; outsiders get only harmless narrative

modes.name_en: The Method of Converting the Creviced Position
modes.category: 方法论/逆境与处境转化
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐一生的结构性困境是'牛李党争'：他先受牛党令狐楚培养、由令狐绹延誉登第，后娶李党王茂元之女——在两党眼中他都是'背恩者'，从此'虚负凌云万丈才，一生襟抱未曾开'，终身沉沦幕府；他的应对不是选边、不是自辩、也不是退隐，而是把夹缝本身变成创作位置：党争的双方都不能用的经验，恰恰是只有他掌握的经验——看见两边的逻辑、看清依附政治的代价；他把这种无处归属的处境写成《贾生》('可怜夜半虚前席，不问苍生问鬼神')、《安定城楼》('永忆江湖归白发，欲回天地入扁舟')——仕途被堵死的人，反而在诗里建立了党争双方都无法没收的独立价值；他证明：当所有阵营都关上门时，夹缝不是死角而是唯一的无人区——无人区里的观察，是站在任何一边的人都得不到的
modes.domain_en: Li Shangyin's structural predicament was the Niu-Li factional strife: raised by the Niu man Linghu Chu and brought to the examinations through Linghu Tao, he then married the daughter of the Li man Wang Maoyuan — to both parties a 'traitor to his patron,' and thereafter 'a talent of ten thousand fathoms held in vain; a life's bosom never opened,' sunk for good in provincial staff posts; his answer was neither to pick a side, nor to plead, nor to withdraw, but to turn the crevice itself into a position for creation: the experience neither faction could use was precisely the experience only he held — seeing the logic of both sides and the true price of patronage politics; he wrote that positionless position into 'On Jia Yi' ('pity, at midnight he leaned forward on the mat — asking not of the people but of ghosts and gods') and the Wall of Anding Tower ('ever I recall the rivers and lakes in white hair, to turn heaven and earth from a little boat'): the man barred from office built in poetry a value neither faction could confiscate; he proved: when every camp has shut its door, the crevice is not a dead end but the only no-man's-land — and the observation from no-man's-land is one no partisan ever gets
modes.source_chapter: 《旧唐书》《新唐书·李商隐传》：'俱无持操，恃才诡激'（旧唐书贬语，恰反映党争视角）；令狐楚授骈文、令狐绹延誉开成二年登第；开成三年（838）娶王茂元女；崔珏《哭李商隐》：'虚负凌云万丈才，一生襟抱未曾开'；李商隐《安定城楼》《贾生》《漫成五章》
modes.key_quote_zh: 虚负凌云万丈才，一生襟抱未曾开——夹缝不是死角，而是唯一的无人区
modes.key_quote_en: "A talent of ten thousand fathoms held in vain; a life's bosom never opened — the crevice is not a dead end but the only no-man's-land."
process_zh: 先承认处境的结构性：区分'我做错了什么'与'我的位置本身决定了敌我'——后者无法靠道歉或努力修复，硬修复只会加深消耗
盘点夹缝的独有资产：两边都不信任你的处境，恰好给了你看清两边的机会——列出'只有站在这里才看得见的东西'
把无处归属转化为独立产出：不向任一阵营申请重新入场，而是把夹缝观察做成两边都无法没收的作品或判断
守住'不为怨恨变形'的底线：夹缝里最容易写成控诉——把怨气升华为对处境普遍规律的洞察，作品才比处境活得长
process_en: Admit the structural nature of the position: separate 'what I did wrong' from 'my position itself sets friend and foe' — the latter no apology or effort can repair, and forcing the repair only deepens the drain
Inventory the crevice's unique assets: the distrust of both sides is exactly the chance to see both — list what can be seen only from here
Convert homelessness into independent output: do not apply for re-admission to either camp; make the crevice's observation into work or judgment neither side can confiscate

Hold the line against being deformed by grievance: the crevice's easiest product is indictment — sublime the resentment into insight about the general law of the position, and the work will outlive the predicament
representative_cases_zh: 《贾生》的反写：被弃置的臣子不写'君恩难测'的怨文，而写'不问苍生问鬼神'——把个人失意升华为对整个用人制度的洞察，使诗的批判力超过任何党派檄文
《安定城楼》的自持：婚后遭谤，不辩恩义，只立'欲回天地入扁舟'的志向坐标与'不知腐鼠成滋味，猜意鹓雏竟未休'的人格界线——用格局回应污名而不是用解释回应
现代对照：冷战时期的跨境学者（如萨义德的流亡写作）——不属于任何阵营的位置成为观察两种体系的双重窗，流亡本身升华为方法论
representative_cases_en: The counter-writing of 'On Jia Yi': the discarded minister writes no plaint of unfathomable favor but 'asking not of the people but of ghosts and gods' — raising private disappointment into insight on the whole system of using men, a critique exceeding any faction's manifesto

The self-possession of Anding Tower: slandered after his marriage, he argues no debt of gratitude, only sets the coordinate 'to turn heaven and earth from a little boat' and the line of character 'they cannot tell the carrion-rat's taste from the phoenix's' — answering stigma with scale, not with explanation

The modern parallel of the border-crossing scholar of the Cold War (say, Said's exile writing): the position belonging to no camp becomes a double window on two systems, exile itself sublimated into method
modern_applications_zh: 职场派系夹缝的'第三方观察'：两个山头相争时，不去猜哪边会赢，而是系统记录两边的决策逻辑与代价——这些记录在尘埃落定后成为最有价值的组织资产
被双方阵营排斥后的'独立判断产品'：把夹缝经验写成行业分析、方法论文章——不申请回归任何一方，让作品成为新的人场券
家族企业或多元关系中的'桥位设计'：被两边都视为'外人'的成员，把身份转化为唯一的中间信任节点，而非反复自证忠诚
modern_applications_en: Third-party observation in office factional strife: when two hills war, do not guess the winner — record systematically the decision logic and costs of both; after the dust settles those records are the organization's most valuable asset

The independent-judgment product after rejection by both camps: write the crevice's experience as industry analysis or method — apply for re-entry to neither, and let the work become your new admission ticket

Bridge-position design in family firms and plural relationships: the member taken by both sides as 'outsider' converts the identity into the one node of intermediate trust, instead of endlessly proving loyalty

modes.domain_zh: 李商隐的七律常打破时空因果链：《马嵬》'此日六军同驻马，当时七夕笑牵牛'——把马嵬兵变的'此日'与长生殿密誓的'当时'直接拼在一起，不加任何过渡词，两句之间巨大的落差由读者自己补全；《夜雨寄北》'何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时'——把未来的想象场景与当下的雨夜叠印，'巴山夜雨'四字在同一首诗中出现两次而毫不重复，因为一次是实、一次是虚；这是电影蒙太奇在唐诗中的提前发明：意义不产生于单个镜头，而产生于镜头的对切——时空跳跃、虚实相生、因果留白，读者的想象被迫成为合著者；他证明：最重的情感重量可以不靠形容词而靠结构承载——把两个画面放在一起，落差本身就是意义
modes.domain_en: Li Shangyin's regulated verse often breaks the chain of time, space and cause: in 'At Mawei,' 'this day the six armies halted their horses; that time, on the seventh night, they laughed at the Herd Boy' — the mutiny's 'this day' cut hard against the secret vow's 'that time,' no transition word between, the vast gap to be completed by the reader alone; in 'Night Rain, Sent North,' 'when shall we trim the candle at the west window together, and speak again of the night rain on Ba mountain' — an imagined future overlaid on the present rainy night, 'night rain on Ba mountain' twice in one poem and never repeated, once real and once imagined; it is the cinema montage invented early in Tang verse: meaning arises not from a single shot but from the cut between shots — leaping time, real and virtual begetting each other, cause left blank, the reader's imagination forced into co-authorship; he proved: the heaviest emotional weight can be carried not by adjectives but by structure — put two pictures side by side and the gap itself is the meaning
modes.source_chapter: 李商隐《马嵬》：'此日六军同驻马，当时七夕笑牵牛'；《夜雨寄北》：'君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时'；《安定城楼》；杜甫《秋兴八首》的时空并置为其直接先驱；钱锺书《谈艺录》论义山诗'以想象纵横出之'
modes.key_quote_zh: 此日六军同驻马，当时七夕笑牵牛——落差本身就是意义
modes.key_quote_en: "This day the six armies halted their horses; that time, on the seventh night, they laughed at the Herd Boy — the gap itself is the meaning."
process_zh: 先找到'落差最大的两个画面'：把要表达的东西拆成两个时空/虚实状态，选择对比最强烈的一对——强度来自落差而不是画面本身的华丽
删除一切过渡与解释：不用'然而''想当年'之类的连接词——对切直接发生，因果留给读者补全
让关键意象在虚实两种状态中各出现一次：同一物象实写一次、虚写一次（如'巴山夜雨'），虚实互证而语义加深
以留白控制解读方向：不写结论句，但通过画面的排序与对位暗中规定读者感受的方向——留白是精确的，不是含糊的
process_en: First find the two pictures of greatest gap: split what you mean into two states of time or of the real and imagined, and choose the pair of sharpest contrast — strength comes from the gap, not from ornate images
Delete every transition and explanation: no 'yet,' no 'once upon a time' connectors — the cut happens directly, cause left for the reader to complete

Let the key image appear once in each state, real and virtual: the same object written once actual, once imagined (as 'night rain on Ba mountain'), the two verifying each other and deepening the sense
Steer reading by blankness, not by vagueness: no concluding sentence, but the ordering and counterpoint of the pictures quietly fix the direction of feeling — the blank is precise, not vague
representative_cases_zh: 《马嵬》的政治批判：不写一句'荒淫误国'的评语，只把七夕笑牵牛与六军驻马对切——玄宗由情人降为囚徒的全过程压缩进一联，批判力千钧
《夜雨寄北》的回环：二十八字中'巴山夜雨'实虚各一、'期'字两见——当下之孤与未来之暖互为镜像，成为唐诗中最完美的循环结构
现代对照：爱森斯坦的蒙太奇理论——'两个镜头的对列不是二数之和而是新数'，与义山对切法在原理上完全同构；塔可夫斯基《镜子》的时空叠印亦然
representative_cases_en: The political critique of 'At Mawei': not one word of judgment like 'pleasure ruining the state,' only the cut from laughing at the Herd Boy to the halted armies — the whole descent of Xuanzong from lover to prisoner compressed into one couplet, the critique weighing a thousand pounds

The loop of 'Night Rain, Sent North': in twenty-eight characters 'night rain on Ba mountain' appears once real and once imagined, 'promise' twice — present loneliness and future warmth mirroring each other, the most perfect circular structure in Tang verse
The modern parallel of Eisenstein's montage: 'the juxtaposition of two shots is not their sum but a new number' — isomorphic in principle with Li's cut; Tarkovsky's overlaid times in Mirror likewise
modern_applications_zh: 叙事性报告的'对切结构'：把'我们承诺的'与'实际发生的'两页直接并排放置，不加评论——决策者自己补全的落差比任何说教都更有效
产品与品牌的'场景蒙太奇'：广告不写卖点形容词，直接对切'使用前的困境'与'使用后的场景'——意义由观众在落差中自行生成
复盘与汇报的'关键意象重复'：让核心数据/意象在'当时'与'现在'两个语境各出现一次——重复即对比，比口头强调深刻
modern_applications_en: The cut structure in narrative reports: set 'what we promised' and 'what happened' directly side by side, no commentary — the gap the decision-maker completes alone persuades more than any sermon
Scene montage for product and brand: no adjective-selling; cut straight from the predicament before use to the scene after — meaning generated by the audience inside the gap
The repeated key image in reviews and reports: let the core figure or image appear once in the 'then' context and once in the 'now' — repetition as contrast, deeper than spoken emphasis

modes.category: 方法论/风险规避与表达安全
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐的《无题》诗是他最重要的发明之一：十五首左右最重要的爱情/托喻诗不署题目——不写'赠某某'、不写'感怀'，连一个安全的通用题目都不给；这不是偷懒而是精密的风险工程：一个题目就是一份证据（'赠柳枝'等于指认对象，'感怀'等于自认寄托），而无题使诗歌在语义上'无主'——诗中人不可指认、诗中事不可对号、诗人意图不可坐实；同时，'无题'作为招牌本身成了品牌：读者看见'无题'就知道进入了义山特有的密写区；他证明：在表达有风险的环境里，'匿名不是表达的损失而是表达的条件'——取消可对号的坐标，表达才能抵达它真正要抵达的地方
modes.domain_en: Li Shangyin's 'Untitled' poems are among his chief inventions: some fifteen of his most important love and allegorical poems carry no title — not 'To So-and-so,' not 'Reflections,' not even a safe generic heading; not laziness but exact risk engineering: a title is evidence ('to the willow' names the beloved; 'reflections' confesses allegory), and the untitled makes the poem semantically ownerless — the person in the poem cannot be identified, the events cannot be matched, the poet's intent cannot be fixed; meanwhile 'Untitled' as a sign became a brand of its own: readers seeing it know they enter Li's special zone of cipher writing; he proved: where expression is risky, anonymity is not the loss of expression but its condition — cancel the coordinates by which it could be matched, and expression can reach what it truly means to reach
modes.source_chapter: 李商隐《无题》组诗（'相见时难别亦难''昨夜星辰昨夜风''飒飒东风细雨来'等十五首左右）；'无题'体式溯源：唐代试帖诗有'赋得'体而无题先例，义山首创以'无题'为题；纪昀、冯浩诸家笺注对无题诗托意之争
modes.key_quote_zh: 相见时难别亦难——匿名不是表达的损失，而是表达的条件
modes.key_quote_en: "Hard was our meeting, hard our parting — anonymity is not the loss of expression but its condition."
process_zh: 先做'坐标审计'：列出文本中所有可能被对号的坐标（人名、时间、地点、事件、题目）——每一个坐标都是一份可被使用的证据
对高危坐标逐个'去指认化'：删改或抽象化处理，但保留情感的密度与意象的个性——匿名不等于平淡，义山的无题诗恰恰是唐诗中私人性最强的
建立'读者分流'机制：让外层读者拿到无主的审美文本，让内层读者通过私设的意象暗号（如'蓬山''青鸟'的复现）读出所指——暗号系统要在收件人之间事先约定
让匿名本身成为识别标志：'无题'从防御工事变成品牌——稳定的密写风格使知音无需题目即可认出你
process_en: Run a coordinates audit first: list every coordinate in the text that could be matched (names, dates, places, events, the title itself) — each is usable evidence

De-identify the high-risk coordinates one by one: delete or abstract them while keeping the density of feeling and the individuality of the images — anonymous is not bland; Li's Untitled poems are the most personal in Tang verse

Build reader stratification: the outer reader gets an ownerless aesthetic text; the inner reader follows privately set image-signals (the recurrences of 'Pengshan,' the 'bluebird') to read the referent — the signal system must be agreed between sender and receiver in advance
Let anonymity become the signature: 'Untitled' turns from defensive works into brand — a stable cipher style lets the kindred recognize you with no title at all
representative_cases_zh: 《无题·相见时难》：对象、事件、场合全部无坐标，而'春蚕到死丝方尽'的私人强度冠绝唐诗——千年来无人能指认收信人，但每个真心人都能对号入座
《无题·昨夜星辰》的暗号系统：'身无彩凤双飞翼，心有灵犀一点通'——'灵犀'成为与特定接收者共享的私钥，外层读者读出爱情哲学，内层读者读出具体的人
现代对照：苏联时期的'潜在写作'（如曼德尔施塔姆手稿）与网络时代的化名写作——匿名保护使写作能在审查下存活，且化名本身积累信用
representative_cases_en: Untitled, 'Hard was our meeting': no coordinate of person, event or occasion, yet the private intensity of 'the silkworm spins to death' crowns Tang verse — in a thousand years no one has named the addressee, yet every true heart matches itself

The signal system of Untitled, 'Last night's stars': 'no paired phoenix wings on our bodies, yet one point of the magic rhinoceros horn links our hearts' — 'the magic horn' as a private key shared with a particular receiver; the outer reader reads a philosophy of love, the inner reader a particular person
The modern parallel of samizdat writing under the Soviet regime and of noms de plume online: anonymity lets writing survive censorship, and the pseudonym itself accumulates credit
modern_applications_zh: 敏感环境的'无主文本'写作：内部备忘、公开评论中删除可对号的坐标（名字用角色代称、日期模糊化），但保留判断的全部锐度——审查者无可乘之隙，同侪读得出所指
举报与吹哨的'去指认化'结构：举报材料以制度缺陷为主语而非以个人恩怨为主语——让问题在语义上'无主'，防止被转化为私人纠纷
个人品牌的'密写区'经营：在通用账号下设一个只有圈内人懂的子栏目/暗语体系——公开层安全，内层传递真实信息
modern_applications_en: Ownerless text in sensitive settings: strip matchable coordinates from internal memos and public comment (roles for names, blurred dates) while keeping every degree of the judgment's edge — the censor finds no handle, peers read the referent

The de-identified structure of whistleblowing: let institutional defects be the subject, not private grievance — render the problem semantically ownerless so it cannot be converted into a personal dispute
Running a cipher zone of one's own brand: under a public account, a sub-column or signal system only the circle understands — the open layer stays safe, the inner layer carries the real message
modes.definition_zh: 李商隐的《无题》诗是他最重要的发明之一：十五首左右最重要的爱情/托喻诗不署题目——不写'赠某某'、不写'感怀'，连一个安全的通用题目都不给；这不是偷懒而是精密的风险工程：一个题目就是一份证据（'赠柳枝'等于指认对象，'感怀'等于自认寄托），而无题使诗歌在语义上'无主'——诗中人不可指认、诗中事不可对号、诗人意图不可坐实；同时，'无题'作为招牌本身成了品牌：读者看见'无题'就知道进入了义山特有的密写区；他证明：在表达有风险的环境里，'匿名不是表达的损失而是表达的条件'——取消可对号的坐标，表达才能抵达它真正要抵达的地方
modes.definition_en: Li Shangyin's 'Untitled' poems are among his chief inventions: some fifteen of his most important love and allegorical poems carry no title — not 'To So-and-so,' not 'Reflections,' not even a safe generic heading; not laziness but exact risk engineering: a title is evidence ('to the willow' names the beloved; 'reflections' confesses allegory), and the untitled makes the poem semantically ownerless — the person in the poem cannot be identified, the events cannot be matched, the poet's intent cannot be fixed; meanwhile 'Untitled' as a sign became a brand of its own: readers seeing it know they enter Li's special zone of cipher writing; he proved: where expression is risky, anonymity is not the loss of expression but its condition — cancel the coordinates by which it could be matched, and expression can reach what it truly means to reach

modes.domain_zh: 李商隐《樊南文集》自述为文'行道不系今古，直挥笔为文'，而其诗论的实质是一条向内的路径：当外部世界无路可走（仕途被党争封死、功业无从建立），他把掘进的深度全部转向内部经验——不是逃避现实，而是把'个人处境'当作与'天下大势'同等严肃的认识对象来研究：《乐游原》'夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏'把一个傍晚的登临挖成对一切美好事物之有限性的哲学直觉；《嫦娥》'嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心'把孤独挖到'选择了高洁就选择了永恒孤寂'的存在层面；别人写景是向外看，他写景是向内钻——同一轮夕阳、同一片月色，他总能掘到比任何同时代人更深一层；他证明：当外部空间被封锁时，内部空间就是最后的疆域——向内的掘进不产生逃跑者，而产生把私人经验提炼成普遍认识的人
modes.domain_en: In the South Fan Collection Li Shangyin says of his writing, 'the Way I walk owes nothing to past or present; I take up the brush and write' — and the substance of his poetics is an inward path: with the outer world closed (career sealed by faction, achievement impossible), he turned the whole depth of his digging onto inner experience — not fleeing reality, but taking 'the personal situation' as an object of knowledge as serious as 'the condition of the realm': in 'The Happy Plain,' 'boundless good the setting sun — only, dusk is near' digs a single evening's climb into a philosophical intuition of the finitude of all good things; 'Chang'e,' 'Chang'e must repent the stolen elixir — blue sea, blue sky, night after night her heart,' digs loneliness down to the existential plane where choosing purity is choosing perpetual solitude; where others look outward at scenery he bores inward through it — the same sunset, the same moonlight, always one layer deeper than any contemporary; he proved: when outer space is locked, inner space is the last frontier — inward digging produces not fugitives but those who distill private experience into universal knowledge
modes.source_chapter: 李商隐《乐游原》：'夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏'；《嫦娥》：'嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心'；《樊南文集》自序；'虚负凌云万丈才'（崔珏挽诗）所概括的处境；纪昀评义山诗'深情绵邈'
modes.key_quote_zh: 夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏——外部空间被封锁时，内部空间是最后的疆域
modes.key_quote_en: "Boundless good the setting sun — only, dusk is near: when outer space is locked, inner space is the last frontier."
process_zh: 把'我的处境'升格为研究课题：不把它当不幸来忍受，而当成一个亟待认识的现象——提出'我的处境揭示了什么普遍结构'的问题
选一个具体物象向下钻：不让思绪漫散，而是钉住一个眼前之物（一轮落日、一夜月色），逼它交出超出自身的意义
在'好在哪'与'憾在哪'的交界处停笔：最深的一层永远在美好与有限的裂缝处（'无限好'与'近黄昏'）——不要绕开裂缝去写纯净的赞美或纯粹的哀叹
以疑问句收束而非断语：'应悔偷灵药'的'应'字保持推断而非宣判——向内掘进的结论永远比确定的认识多留一层
process_en: Promote 'my situation' to a research problem: not something to endure as misfortune but a phenomenon demanding knowledge — ask what general structure the situation reveals
Pin one concrete object and bore downward: let no thought scatter; fix on a thing at hand (one setting sun, one night's moon) and force it to yield meaning beyond itself

Stop at the seam of 'wherein good' and 'wherein fleeting': the deepest layer always lies in the crack between the beautiful and the finite ('boundless good' against 'dusk is near') — do not skirt the crack for pure praise or pure lament
Close with a question, not a verdict: the 'must' of 'must repent the stolen elixir' keeps inference, not sentence — the conclusion dug inward always holds one layer more than certain knowledge
representative_cases_zh: 《乐游原》的二十字哲学：一次寻常登高被挖成对'美好即有限'的直觉把握——后世'夕阳无限好'成为汉语中一切'盛极将衰'之感的通用表达式
《嫦娥》的存在论孤独：把闺怨诗的常套挖到'选择与代价'的层面——偷灵药=选择高洁/超越，夜夜心=其永恒代价，神话在此被改写为存在寓言
现代对照：普鲁斯特把被禁锢的卧床岁月变成《追忆》——外部空间越小，向内的掘进越深，私人记忆成为普遍认识的矿脉
representative_cases_en: Twenty characters of philosophy in 'The Happy Plain': an ordinary climb dug into an intuition that the beautiful is finite — 'boundless good the setting sun' became the universal formula in Chinese for all sense of height about to fall

The existential loneliness of 'Chang'e': the stock of the boudoir lament dug to the plane of choice and price — stealing the elixir as choosing transcendence, the heart night after night as its perpetual cost, myth rewritten as existential parable
The modern parallel of Proust turning his bedridden confinement into the Search: the smaller the outer space, the deeper the inward bore — private memory a vein of universal knowledge
modern_applications_zh: 职业停滞期的'内部课题化'：晋升无望时，把'为什么我被卡在这里'从怨气转为研究问题——对组织晋升机制的私人观察常成为后来最有价值的行业洞察
日常物象的'深挖练习'：每天选一个眼前之物写五十字，规则是必须写出超出该物自身的意义——训练'向里掘进'的认知肌肉
情绪处理的'裂缝定位法'：不绕开矛盾情绪，而是钉住'好在哪/憾在哪'的交界处写下来——最深认识总在裂缝处而非在纯净情绪中
modern_applications_en: Internalizing a stalled career: when promotion is sealed, turn 'why am I stuck here' from resentment into a research question — private observation of the promotion machinery often becomes one's most valuable industry insight
The daily dig on an ordinary object: fifty characters daily on one thing before you, rule being it must yield meaning beyond itself — training the muscle of inward digging
The seam-locating method for emotion: do not skirt ambivalence; pin and write down the seam of 'wherein good / wherein fleeting' — the deepest knowledge always at the crack, never in pure feeling

modes.name_en: The Method of Reviving the Allusion
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐用典是唐诗中密度最高、却从不显得是'掉书袋'的：他的秘诀不是引用典故而是改造典故——《贾生》写汉文帝'不问苍生问鬼神'，史实完全成立，但视角被彻底翻转：史书 celebrate 的是文帝深夜召见贤臣的求贤佳话，李商隐把镜头对准'问了什么'——同一个事件，翻转视角后批判力完全重铸；《嫦娥》不是引用嫦娥奔月的既有叙事，而是追问神话没写的部分（奔月之后她悔不悔）——在既有故事的空白处继续往下写；'庄生晓梦迷蝴蝶'把庄周的哲学寓言压缩进一句诗的意象层面，哲学被转化为情绪质感；他证明：典故的最高用法不是'证明我知道'而是'重审旧案'——把人人熟知的材料重新审视一遍，让旧故事交出它从未交出的意义
modes.domain_en: Li Shangyin's allusions are the densest in Tang verse yet never smell of pedantry: his secret is not to cite but to rework — in 'On Jia Yi,' the Emperor Wen 'asked not of the people but of ghosts and gods': the history stands, but the angle is wholly turned — the chronicles celebrate the midnight summons of a worthy as a paragon of seeking talent; Li points the lens at what was asked — the same event, its critical force reforged by the turned view; 'Chang'e' does not retell the myth of flight to the moon but presses on what the myth left unwritten (did she repent, after?) — writing on into the blank of the known story; 'Zhuangzi at dawn dreamed, bewildered, the butterfly' compresses Zhuangzi's philosophical parable into the image-texture of a single line, philosophy turned into felt quality; he proved: the highest use of an allusion is not 'to prove I know' but 'to rehear the old case' — re-examine what everyone knows and make the old story yield the meaning it never yielded
modes.source_chapter: 李商隐《贾生》：'宣室求贤访逐臣，贾生才调更无伦。可怜夜半虚前席，不问苍生问鬼神'；《史记·屈原贾生列传》孝文帝'前席'本事；《嫦娥》；《锦瑟》用庄周梦蝶、望帝啼鹃、鲛人泣珠、蓝田玉烟四典；黄庭坚称'于义山为得髓'；元好问'独恨无人作郑笺'
modes.key_quote_zh: 可怜夜半虚前席，不问苍生问鬼神——典故的最高用法不是证明我知道，而是重审旧案
modes.key_quote_en: "Pity, at midnight he leaned forward on the mat — asking not of the people but of ghosts and gods: the highest use of an allusion is not to prove I know but to rehear the old case."
process_zh: 把熟悉材料当'未决案件'而非'已知事实'：对任何经典叙事先问三个问题——叙事者站在谁的角度？哪些部分没被写？如果翻转视角结论还成立吗？
在旧故事的空白处往下写：寻找典故中'之后怎样''为何如此'的未答之问——神话的沉默处正是新意义的矿脉（嫦娥奔月之后的悔）
翻转评估视角而不篡改事实：《贾生》所用史料无一虚构，只是把'求贤'的赞颂视角换成'问了什么'的审视视角——批判力来自视角而非虚构
把哲理压缩为意象质感：引用思想时不要复述论证，把结论熔铸成可感的画面（庄周梦蝶→'晓梦迷蝴蝶'）——让读者带着画面去自行回到哲学
process_en: Treat familiar material as an open case, not known fact: of any classic narrative ask three questions — whose angle does the narrator take? what parts went unwritten? does the conclusion survive if the angle is turned?

Write on into the blank of the old story: find the unanswered questions of 'what after' and 'why so' in the allusion — the myth's silence is the vein of new meaning (Chang'e's repentance after the flight)

Turn the angle of judgment without touching the facts: 'On Jia Yi' invents nothing in the record; it only exchanges the laudatory angle of 'seeking the worthy' for the examining angle of 'what was asked' — critical force from the angle, not from fiction

Compress thought into image-texture: in citing an idea, do not restate the argument — cast its conclusion into a felt picture (Zhuangzi's dream → 'at dawn dreamed, bewildered, the butterfly'), and let the reader walk back to the philosophy by way of the image
representative_cases_zh: 《贾生》的千古翻案：《史记》原文是文帝'问鬼神之本'的实录，司马迁并未作价值判断——李商隐从纯事实中翻出批判，'不问苍生问鬼神'七个字成为此后一千年评价统治者求贤诚意的通用标尺
《嫦娥》的神话补写：奔月神话只写到'奔'为止——李商隐从被所有人略过的'之后'继续写，把一个解释自然现象的神话重写为选择与代价的寓言
现代对照：昆德拉重审荷马与塞万提斯的美学判决、鲁迅速从'二十四孝'翻出'吃人'——对旧文本的批判性重读是思想史最常用的引擎
representative_cases_en: The eternal retrial of 'On Jia Yi': the Shiji records only that Wen asked 'of the root of ghosts and gods,' Sima Qian judging nothing — Li drew critique out of pure fact, and the seven words 'asked not of the people but of ghosts and gods' became the standing measure of a ruler's sincerity in seeking the worthy for the next thousand years
The myth continued in 'Chang'e': the flight myth ends at the flight — Li writes on from the 'after' everyone skips, rewriting a myth of natural explanation into a parable of choice and price

The modern parallel of Kundera rehearing the aesthetic verdicts on Homer and Cervantes, or Lu Xun reading 'cannibalism' out of the Twenty-four Filial Exemplars: critical rereading of old texts is thought history's commonest engine
modern_applications_zh: 行业分析'旧案重审'：对公认的行业叙事（如某次著名成功案例）问'叙事者站在谁的角度、哪些没被写'——翻转视角后的分析往往比新数据更有洞察
案例教学的'补写之后'：商学院案例都停在决策点上——让学生继续写'决策之后的第三年'，在既有故事的空白处训练判断
引用的'意象化压缩'：写报告引用经典理论时，把结论压成一个可复用的画面/公式而非复述原文——降低读者的认知成本同时显示真正消化
modern_applications_en: Rehearing the old case in industry analysis: of accepted narratives (a famous success story, say) ask whose angle the narrator takes and what went unwritten — the turned angle often out-insights new data
Writing 'after' in case teaching: business cases stop at the decision point — have students write the third year after, training judgment in the blank of the known story

Image-compression in citation: quoting a classic theory in a report, compress the conclusion into a reusable picture or formula instead of restating it — cutting the reader's cognitive cost while proving true digestion

modes.name_en: The Method of Deep Feeling and Cold Eye
modes.category: 方法论/情感管理与判断
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐诗的独特质地是'深情'与'冷眼'的并存：'春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干'是唐诗中最极端的深情表达——至死方尽的执念；但紧接着《无题·相见时难》的尾联却是'蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看'——明知不可为而托付神话信使的、清醒到近乎自我讽刺的一笔；《嫦娥》为孤独挖到存在深度，但'应悔'二字是推断而非沉溺；他的深情从不失控，因为总有一只冷眼在计量：计量这段感情/这个执念的代价、边界与结局；这份冷眼来自他的处境——一个在党争夹缝中必须时刻自控的人，把'情绪的计量'练成了本能；他证明：深情与冷静不是对立选项而是双轨——全情投入与清醒计价可以在同一个人、同一首诗、甚至同一个瞬间共存，且唯有共存，深情才不至自毁
modes.domain_en: The unique texture of Li Shangyin's poetry is the coexistence of deep feeling and the cold eye: 'the silkworm spins its silk to death, the candle's tears dry only when burnt out' is the most extreme depth of feeling in Tang verse — devotion to the very end; yet the close of the same Untitled poem is 'Pengshan is not many roads from here — bluebird, be diligent and go look' — a line lucid to the point of self-irony, entrusting the message to a mythical bird while knowing the case is hopeless; 'Chang'e' digs loneliness to existential depth, yet the 'must' of 'must repent' is inference, not drowning; his feeling never loses control because a cold eye is always tallying: tallying the price, the boundary, the ending of this devotion; the eye came from his position — a man in the crevice of faction who had to govern himself every hour made 'the metering of feeling' instinct; he proved: deep feeling and coldness are not opposed options but twin tracks — total investment and lucid pricing can coexist in one person, one poem, one instant, and only in coexistence does the devotion not destroy itself
modes.source_chapter: 《无题·相见时难别亦难》全诗结构：颔联'春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干'与尾联'蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看'的并存；《嫦娥》'应悔偷灵药'的推断语气；李商隐《上河东公启》等自陈处境文字；纪昀评'深情绵邈'与钱锺书论义山诗之'蕴藉'
modes.key_quote_zh: 春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干——深情与冷眼双轨，深情才不至自毁
modes.key_quote_en: "The silkworm spins its silk to death, the candle's tears dry only when burnt out — deep feeling and the cold eye on twin tracks, or the devotion destroys itself."
process_zh: 允许深情到极端，但给计量留出固定通道：写下来、说出来时全情投入，但每天留一个'计价时刻'——盘点这段投入的代价、边界与退出条件
把冷眼写成'下一步动作'而非'否定情绪'：《无题》的尾联不是收回深情，而是'青鸟探看'——明知不可为仍设计一个可执行的最小动作
用'应'字守住推断语气：对自己最深处的情绪（悔、怨、执）保持'应悔''也许'的假设句式——沉溺于断语是失控的开始
让讽刺成为安全阀：对自身处境保留一丝自嘲（明知蓬山无路仍托青鸟）——自嘲不是消解深情，而是防止深情变成自我伤害
process_en: Permit feeling to the extreme, but keep a fixed channel for the meter: invest wholly when you write or speak, yet reserve a daily 'pricing moment' — tally the cost, the boundary and the exit terms of the investment
Write the cold eye as a next action, not a denial of feeling: the Untitled close is no retraction but 'send the bluebird to look' — knowing the case hopeless, still design one executable minimal move
Hold the inferential mood with 'must' or 'perhaps': toward your own deepest emotions (regret, resentment, obsession) keep the hypothetical form — drowning in verdicts is where losing control begins

Let irony be the safety valve: keep one thread of self-mockery toward your own position (entrusting the bluebird, knowing Pengshan has no road) — self-irony does not dissolve the devotion; it keeps the devotion from becoming self-harm
representative_cases_zh: 《无题·相见时难》的完整结构：颔联到死的深情（蚕、蜡）→ 颈联晓镜夜吟的悬想 → 尾联青鸟探看的清醒托付——深情、悬想、冷眼三层在一首诗内完成，这是情绪管理的完整工艺
李商隐的政治书启：在令狐绹处的陈情文字（《寄令狐郎中》等）同样双轨——情见乎辞而字字有分寸，深情求助但不失人格界限
现代对照：巴顿式的'战场激情+参谋部计算'，或风险投资中'信念上全仓、头寸上对冲'的纪律——深情与计价双轨是一切高风险事业的通用结构
representative_cases_en: The complete architecture of Untitled, 'Hard was our meeting': couplet two's devotion to the death (silk, wax), couplet three's suspended imagining of mirror and night-chant, the close's lucid entrusting to the bluebird — feeling, imagining and cold eye, three layers finished inside one poem: the full craft of governing emotion
Li's political letters, as those to Linghu Tao, run the same twin track — feeling visible in every line yet each word measured; deep-feeling appeal without surrender of personal dignity

The modern parallel of the commander's battle passion plus staff calculation, or venture discipline of 'full conviction, hedged position' — deep feeling and cold pricing as the universal structure of all high-risk undertakings
modern_applications_zh: 高风险承诺的'双轨账户'：对事业/关系全情投入的同时，单独维护一个'计价文档'（每月更新：代价、边界、退出条件）——投入不因计量而减少，风险因计量而可控
谈判与求助的'青鸟动作'：明知大概率被拒绝的请求，仍设计一个最小、体面、可执行的动作发出——冷眼体现在动作的最小化，而非放弃
情绪写作的'应字练习'：写日记/信件时，对最深的怨与执使用'应悔''也许'句式——把宣判降为推断，情绪的深度不减而失控风险大降
modern_applications_en: The twin-track ledger for high-stakes commitment: invest wholly in the venture or relationship while separately keeping a pricing document (monthly: cost, boundary, exit terms) — investment undiminished by metering, risk bounded by it
The bluebird move in negotiation and appeal: for a request very likely refused, still design one minimal, dignified, executable action — the cold eye in minimizing the move, not in abandoning it

The 'must' exercise in emotional writing: in diaries and letters, keep the deepest resentment and obsession in hypothetical form — verdicts reduced to inference, depth undiminished, risk of losing control much reduced
modes.definition_zh: 李商隐诗的独特质地是'深情'与'冷眼'的并存：'春蚕到死丝方尽，蜡炬成灰泪始干'是唐诗中最极端的深情表达——至死方尽的执念；但紧接着《无题·相见时难》的尾联却是'蓬山此去无多路，青鸟殷勤为探看'——明知不可为而托付神话信使的、清醒到近乎自我讽刺的一笔；《嫦娥》为孤独挖到存在深度，但'应悔'二字是推断而非沉溺；他的深情从不失控，因为总有一只冷眼在计量：计量这段感情/这个执念的代价、边界与结局；这份冷眼来自他的处境——一个在党争夹缝中必须时刻自控的人，把'情绪的计量'练成了本能；他证明：深情与冷静不是对立选项而是双轨——全情投入与清醒计价可以在同一个人、同一首诗、甚至同一个瞬间共存，且唯有共存，深情才不至自毁
modes.definition_en: The unique texture of Li Shangyin's poetry is the coexistence of deep feeling and the cold eye: 'the silkworm spins its silk to death, the candle's tears dry only when burnt out' is the most extreme depth of feeling in Tang verse — devotion to the very end; yet the close of the same Untitled poem is 'Pengshan is not many roads from here — bluebird, be diligent and go look' — a line lucid to the point of self-irony, entrusting the message to a mythical bird while knowing the case is hopeless; 'Chang'e' digs loneliness to existential depth, yet the 'must' of 'must repent' is inference, not drowning; his feeling never loses control because a cold eye is always tallying: tallying the price, the boundary, the ending of this devotion; the eye came from his position — a man in the crevice of faction who had to govern himself every hour made 'the metering of feeling' instinct; he proved: deep feeling and coldness are not opposed options but twin tracks — total investment and lucid pricing can coexist in one person, one poem, one instant, and only in coexistence does the devotion not destroy itself

modes.name_en: The Method of the Chancery Forge
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐一生没有显赫官职，却做过二十年幕府书记：为节度使写奏折、书启、祭文——体制内的应制文字本是最消磨人的差事，他却把它变成了技艺锻炉：他向令狐楚学骈文，'樊南四六'成为唐代骈文最后的高峰；更重要的是公文写作反哺了他的诗——骈文对仗的精严、用典的分寸、字句的不可增删，全部进入七律：'沧海月明珠有泪，蓝田日暖玉生烟'每个字都经过公文级的锻打；他白天写的是别人要用的文字，晚上写的是自己要留的文字，两套文字互相淬火；他证明：职业性写作不是创作的敌人而是锻炉——最严格的应用文体约束，恰恰是诗艺最深的基础训练；被限制死的格式里练出的自由，比任意挥洒的自由珍贵得多
modes.domain_en: Li Shangyin held no great office, but served twenty years as a staff secretary: drafting memorials, letters and eulogies for military governors — the most wearing of official chores, and he turned it into a forge: he learned parallel prose from Linghu Chu, and the 'Four-Six of Fannan' became the last high peak of Tang parallel prose; more, the chancery fed back into his poems — the exactness of the antithesis, the measure of allusion, the impossibility of adding or removing a word, all entered the regulated verse: every character of 'moonlight on the blue sea — pearls have tears; warm sun on Lantian — jade gives off smoke' was forged to chancery grade; by day he wrote what others needed, by night what he meant to keep, the two scripts quenching each other; he proved: professional writing is not the enemy of creation but its forge — the strictest constraints of applied prose are precisely the deepest training of the poetic craft; freedom trained inside a locked form is worth far more than freedom at large
modes.source_chapter: 李商隐《樊南甲集序》《乙集序》自述四六文结集：'樊南四六'之称；《旧唐书》本传'博学强记，下笔不能自休'；令狐楚授其骈文之史实（'自蒙半夜传衣后，不羡王祥得佩刀'）；《夜雨寄北》《锦瑟》等七律的炼字密度；刘学锴、余恕诚《李商隐诗歌集解》
modes.key_quote_zh: 沧海月明珠有泪，蓝田日暖玉生烟——被限制死的格式里练出的自由，比任意挥洒的自由珍贵得多
modes.key_quote_en: "Moonlight on the blue sea — pearls have tears; warm sun on Lantian — jade gives off smoke: freedom trained inside a locked form is worth far more than freedom at large."
process_zh: 把'差事文字'当技艺课而非消耗：接到最枯燥的格式化写作任务时，给自己加一道约束（用典更省、对仗更严、字数再减）——在必做的劳动上加码自训
让应用文与创作'互相淬火'：白天公文练出的精确，晚上创作时用；创作中练出的语感，白天公文里用——两套文字共享一个听觉标准
以'不可增删'为达标线：每个句子做完做一遍'删字测试'与'添字测试'——任何一个字可删可换，就还没到义山式的锻打标准
把约束归档为个人文体库：应制文字中最难的段落（最难写的场合、最难措辞的褒贬）单独留存——这些是最稀缺的写作经验
process_en: Treat chore-writing as craft class, not drain: on the dullest formatted task, add one constraint of your own (sparer allusion, stricter antithesis, fewer words) — training laid on top of obligatory labor

Quench applied prose and creation against each other: the exactness forged by day's documents used in the night's poems; the ear trained in poems used in the next day's documents — one standard of hearing shared by both scripts
Take 'nothing to add or remove' as the pass line: after every sentence run the deletion test and the addition test — if any character can go or be swapped, the Li-grade forging is not yet reached

Archive constraints into a personal style library: keep separately the hardest passages of official writing (the hardest occasions, the finest calibration of praise and blame) — these are the scarcest experience in writing
representative_cases_zh: '樊南四六'的传承：李商隐把令狐楚所授骈文推到唐代的最后高峰，其《祭小侄女寄寄文》《上河东公启》至今为骈文范本——二十年'替别人写字'没有磨掉他，反而沉淀为他个人的技术资产
公文对仗反哺七律：'沧海月明珠有泪，蓝田日暖玉生烟'一联的对仗精度——地名对地名、月对日、物性对物性、虚字位置严丝合缝——正是四六文的纪律移植
现代对照：律师出身的小说家（卡夫卡、狄更斯）与记者出身的作家（海明威）——应用文体的严格训练成为文学技艺的底座，而非绊脚石
representative_cases_en: The heritage of the Fannan Four-Six: Li carried the parallel prose taught by Linghu Chu to the last high peak of Tang, his Eulogy for the Little Niece Jiji and letters to the Prince of Hedong still models of the form — twenty years of 'writing for others' did not grind him down but settled into his personal technical asset

Chancery antithesis feeding the regulated verse: the exactness of 'moonlight on the blue sea — pearls have tears; warm sun on Lantian — jade gives off smoke' — place against place, moon against sun, property against property, function words in perfect register — is Four-Six discipline transplanted

The modern parallel of the lawyer-novelists (Kafka, Dickens) and the journalist-writers (Hemingway): the strict discipline of applied prose as the foundation, not the stumbling block, of literary craft
modern_applications_zh: 把周报/汇报当炼字场：给格式化写作加自设约束（字数减半、每个结论配证据链）——必做的差事变成写作训练，且产出直接可用
技术文档与创作的'共享听觉'：写代码注释/文档练出的精确，用到博客或方案写作里；创作练出的节奏感，反过来让文档更可读
'删字测试'进日常：任何重要邮件/文档发出前做一遍逐字删减——凡可删的都删，留下的每个字都承重
modern_applications_en: The weekly report as forge: add self-set constraints to formatted writing (halve the words, give every conclusion an evidence chain) — obligatory chores become writing training, and the output remains usable

A shared ear between technical docs and creation: the exactness trained in code comments and documentation used in blogs and proposals; the cadence trained in creation returned to make documents more readable
The deletion test daily: before any important email or document, cut character by character — whatever can go, goes; every surviving character bears weight

modes.name_en: The Method of Suspended Judgment and Source Criticism
modes.category: 方法论/认知方法/证据纪律
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐留下的不仅是诗，还有一份认知纪律的样本：他一生行迹被新旧《唐书》记为'俱无持操，恃才诡激'，千年来注家围绕他的婚姻、交游、诗旨聚讼纷纭——而真相的层次（哪句诗写给谁、哪篇启的真意）远比史书断语复杂；现代刘学锴、余恕诚《李商隐诗歌集解》用系年考证的方法逐诗清理：把每首诗放回它写作的确切年份与处境中，让文本与证据互证，而非依赖史书的道德断语——结果推翻了大量沿用千年的旧说（如'放利偷合'的贬评）；这条线索的启示是：当权威断语与文本证据冲突时，回到文本、回到年谱、回到处境，存疑而不站队；他本人的写作策略（无题、密写）与后世的考证传统合起来构成完整的一课：作者用加密对抗污名，考证者用系年对抗断语——两端共同证明：对复杂处境的判断必须让证据走在评语前面
modes.domain_en: Li Shangyin left not only poems but a specimen of cognitive discipline: his life was recorded by the two Tang histories as 'without constancy, willful and provocative,' and for a thousand years annotators have disputed his marriage, his friendships, the intent of his poems — while the strata of truth (to whom a poem is addressed, the real sense of a letter) are far more complex than the histories' verdicts; the modern Collected Interpretations of Liu Xuekai and Yu Shucheng cleared the poems one by one by chronological verification: placing each poem back into its exact year and situation, letting text and evidence check each other instead of trusting the histories' moral verdicts — and overturning many a thousand-year-old slander (such as 'for profit, base compliance'); the lesson of this line: when authoritative verdict and textual evidence conflict, return to the text, the chronology, the situation — suspend judgment and take no side; his own strategy of writing (untitled, ciphered) and the later philological tradition together make one whole lesson: the author used encryption against stigma, the philologist used chronology against verdict — both ends proving that judgment on a complex situation must let evidence walk ahead of the epithet
modes.source_chapter: 《旧唐书·李商隐传》：'俱无持操，恃才诡激，为当涂者所薄，名宦不进，坎壈终身'；《新唐书》'忘家恩，放利偷合'之贬评；刘学锴、余恕诚《李商隐诗歌集解》（1988）的系年考证方法；冯浩《玉谿生诗集笺注》；张采田《玉谿生年谱会笺》
modes.key_quote_zh: 俱无持操——当权威断语与文本证据冲突时，回到文本、回到年谱、回到处境，存疑而不站队
modes.key_quote_en: "'Without constancy': when authoritative verdict and textual evidence conflict, return to the text, the chronology, the situation — suspend judgment and take no side."
process_zh: 识别'断语'与'证据'的层次：面对任何评价（史书评语、绩效评语、舆论定性），先把它标记为'待验证的断语'而非事实——断语的重量与其来源的地位无关
为对象建立'系年档案'：把事件放回确切时间与处境中排列——同一句话在不同年份有完全不同的含义，脱离处境的评价大概率失真
让原始文本与断语对质：逐一核对断语引用的事实是否支持断语本身的结论（旧唐书骂'无持操'，但所举事实皆是婚配与谋生）——证据链断裂处即存疑点
结论按证据强度分级发布：证据充分的可以推翻旧说，证据不足的明确标注'存疑'——宁可留给后人，不可替证据发言
process_en: Sort verdicts from evidence: facing any evaluation (a history's epithet, a performance review, a public labeling), first mark it 'a verdict pending verification,' not fact — the weight of a verdict has nothing to do with the rank of its source

Build a chronological file of the subject: set events back into their exact times and situations — the same sentence means differently in different years, and judgment severed from situation is mostly distorted

Confront the original text with the verdict: check one by one whether the facts the verdict cites support the verdict's own conclusion (the Old Tang History cries 'no constancy,' yet all it instances are marriage and livelihood) — the broken link is where doubt lives

Publish conclusions graded by strength of evidence: where evidence suffices, overturn the old; where it does not, mark 'in doubt' expressly — better to leave it to posterity than to speak for the evidence
representative_cases_zh: 千年贬评的翻案工程：从《旧唐书》'无持操'到清代冯浩、张采田的年谱会笺，再到刘学锴余恕诚的逐诗系年——三个世纪的考证把'背恩者'的断语逐步还原为'夹缝中谋生的具体决策链'，每一次还原都依赖'回到文本'而非'接受定评'
《夜雨寄北》收信人之谜：是'寄内'（妻子王氏）还是'寄北'（长安友人）？注家聚讼数百年，关键证据（王氏卒年与作诗年份）使'寄内'说动摇——学界至今标注存疑而非强行归案
现代对照：敦煌文书的整理对唐代边塞史的重写、档案开放对历史定论的修正——证据层级高于评语层级是一切史学的宪法
representative_cases_en: The retrial of a thousand-year slander: from the Old Tang History's 'no constancy,' through Feng Hao's and Zhang Caitian's annotated chronologies of the Qing, to Liu Xuekai's and Yu Shucheng's poem-by-poem dating — three centuries of philology step by step dissolve the verdict of 'traitor to his patron' into a concrete chain of decisions made for livelihood inside the crevice; every step rode on returning to the text, not accepting the settled judgment

The mystery of the addressee of 'Night Rain, Sent North': to his wife Wang, or to a friend in Chang'an? centuries of dispute; the key evidence (Wang's death year against the poem's date) shakes the wife reading — scholarship marks it in doubt to this day rather than forcing a verdict

The modern parallel of the Dunhuang manuscripts rewriting the history of the frontier, and of opened archives revising settled history: evidence outranks epithet — the constitution of all historiography
modern_applications_zh: 对绩效评语/舆论定性的'系年复核'：被贴标签时，把被引为依据的事件放回时间线逐条核对——脱离处境的定性大概率经不起系年
决策复盘的'断语-证据对质'：复盘不再复述结论，而是把每个结论后面引用的事实单独摆出来核对——证据链断裂处就是这个决策真正的风险点
知识库的'存疑标注'纪律：自己的判断分'已证实/倾向/存疑'三级发布——明确标注存疑的结论反而积累长期信用
modern_applications_en: Chronological recheck of labels: when tagged by a review or public labeling, line the cited events back on the timeline — judgment severed from situation rarely survives dating
Verdict-versus-evidence confrontation in reviews: a retrospective does not restate conclusions but lays out and checks each fact cited behind each — the broken link is the decision's true risk point
The doubt-marking discipline in a knowledge base: publish one's judgments in three grades — verified, leaning, in doubt; conclusions expressly marked in doubt accumulate the longest credit
representative_figures: 李商隐（作为考证对象与密写者的双重样本）
modes.definition_zh: 李商隐留下的不仅是诗，还有一份认知纪律的样本：他一生行迹被新旧《唐书》记为'俱无持操，恃才诡激'，千年来注家围绕他的婚姻、交游、诗旨聚讼纷纭——而真相的层次（哪句诗写给谁、哪篇启的真意）远比史书断语复杂；现代刘学锴、余恕诚《李商隐诗歌集解》用系年考证的方法逐诗清理：把每首诗放回它写作的确切年份与处境中，让文本与证据互证，而非依赖史书的道德断语——结果推翻了大量沿用千年的旧说（如'放利偷合'的贬评）；这条线索的启示是：当权威断语与文本证据冲突时，回到文本、回到年谱、回到处境，存疑而不站队；他本人的写作策略（无题、密写）与后世的考证传统合起来构成完整的一课：作者用加密对抗污名，考证者用系年对抗断语——两端共同证明：对复杂处境的判断必须让证据走在评语前面
modes.definition_en: Li Shangyin left not only poems but a specimen of cognitive discipline: his life was recorded by the two Tang histories as 'without constancy, willful and provocative,' and for a thousand years annotators have disputed his marriage, his friendships, the intent of his poems — while the strata of truth (to whom a poem is addressed, the real sense of a letter) are far more complex than the histories' verdicts; the modern Collected Interpretations of Liu Xuekai and Yu Shucheng cleared the poems one by one by chronological verification: placing each poem back into its exact year and situation, letting text and evidence check each other instead of trusting the histories' moral verdicts — and overturning many a thousand-year-old slander (such as 'for profit, base compliance'); the lesson of this line: when authoritative verdict and textual evidence conflict, return to the text, the chronology, the situation — suspend judgment and take no side; his own strategy of writing (untitled, ciphered) and the later philological tradition together make one whole lesson: the author used encryption against stigma, the philologist used chronology against verdict — both ends proving that judgment on a complex situation must let evidence walk ahead of the epithet

modes.name_en: The Method of Founding a School by Transmission
modes.domain_zh: 李商隐生前是党争弃子，身后却开出了两个流派：其一是直接的'西昆体'——真宗朝杨亿、刘筠、钱惟演等馆阁词臣专学义山，编《西昆酬唱集》二卷二百五十首，西昆体统治宋初诗坛四十年，虽有'挦扯义山'之讥，却把义山诗的用典、对仗与意象经营立为一代标准；其二是更深的暗线——从西昆体到江西派的黄庭坚'点铁成金'，再到宋以后几乎所有写'深情而不可说'之诗的诗人（元好问'望帝春心托杜鹃'即化用义山），李商隐成为处理'不可明说之物'的祖师；一个生前没有任何权力位置的人，靠文本本身的完成度完成了跨代际的组织建设——他证明：开派不必有门墙与讲席，文本就是校舍；只要把一种前人没有的能力（处理不可明说之物）做到无人可及，传灯就是自动的
modes.domain_en: In life a castoff of the factions, after death Li Shangyin founded two schools: the direct one, the Xikun style — the court poets Yang Yi, Liu Yun and Qian Weiyan of Emperor Zhenzong's reign studied Li alone and compiled the two scrolls, two hundred fifty poems, of the Xikun Singing Collection; the Xikun style ruled the early Song for forty years and, mocked as 'plucking Li's feathers,' nonetheless made Li's allusive density, antithesis and image-craft the standard of an age; the second and deeper line runs underground: from the Xikun poets to Huang Tingjian's 'turning iron into gold' in the Jiangxi school, to nearly every poet after the Song who wrote 'deep feeling that cannot be said' (Yuan Haowen's 'the spring heart of the Emperor Wang entrusted to the cuckoo' is Li reworked); Li became the patriarch of handling the unsayable — a man who held no position of power in his lifetime completed trans-generational organization by nothing but the finish of his texts; he proved: founding a school needs no gate and no lectern — the text is the schoolhouse; master one capacity no predecessor had (handling the unsayable) beyond anyone's reach, and the transmission lights itself
modes.source_chapter: 杨亿编《西昆酬唱集》（1005 前后）二卷，杨亿、刘筠、钱惟演十七人唱和；欧阳修《六一诗话》：'盖自杨刘唱和，《西昆集》行，后进学者争效之，风雅一变'；黄庭坚'点铁成金''夺胎换骨'之说；元好问《论诗三十首》'望帝春心托杜鹃'；刘学锴《李商隐传论》论其接受史
modes.key_quote_zh: 开派不必有门墙与讲席，文本就是校舍——把前人没有的能力做到无人可及，传灯是自动的
modes.key_quote_en: "Founding a school needs no gate and no lectern — the text is the schoolhouse: master one capacity no predecessor had beyond anyone's reach, and the transmission lights itself."
process_zh: 把'独有的一门能力'练到时代无人可及：不要追求全面，而是把一件事（处理不可明说之物）做到别人绕不开——学派的核心是能力而非人格
让文本自带'可学的接口'：独门能力必须封装在可拆解的形式里（可仿的体式、可辨认的意象系统、可复用的对句工艺）——不可学的高峰无人传灯
接受'先被模仿后被超越'的传播规律：西昆体学义山得其皮相而失其深情，四十年后被江西派超越——模仿期是传播的必经阶段，不必为皮相模仿焦虑
把'不可说之物'的处理方法留成范式：真正传下去的不是句子而是'如何对待某类问题'的范式——范式比风格活得久
process_en: Train one unique capacity beyond anyone of the age: seek not comprehensiveness but one art (handling the unsayable) that others cannot route around — the core of a school is capacity, not personality

Let the text carry a learnable interface: the unique art must be packaged in analyzable form — imitable structures, a recognizable system of images, reusable couplet craft; an unlearnable peak gathers no lamp

Accept the law of transmission: first imitated, then surpassed: the Xikun poets took Li's surface and lost his depth, and were superseded in forty years by the Jiangxi school — the imitative phase is the necessary stage of spread; be not anxious over surface imitation
Leave the method of handling the unsayable as a paradigm: what truly transmits is not the sentence but the paradigm of 'how to treat a class of problems' — the paradigm outlives the style
representative_cases_zh: 《西昆酬唱集》的组织学意义：十七位馆阁词臣以唱和集的形式把义山诗立为集体训练科目——李商隐本人未参与、未授权、未受益，但他的文本完成了跨代际的'组织建设'，统治宋初诗坛四十年
从西昆到江西的暗线传承：黄庭坚'点铁成金'的用典方法论直接承自义山式的典故活化（M-LIS-006），但公开的师承链条上江西派尊杜甫——真正的传灯常在明线之外
现代对照：图灵奖委员会式的'以论文传灯'与海德格尔'以文本开派'——生前无权力位置的思想者，靠文本完成度实现跨代际的组织建设
representative_cases_en: The organizational sense of the Xikun Singing Collection: seventeen court poets made Li's poetry a collective training subject in the form of a singing collection — Li took no part, granted nothing, gained nothing, yet his text completed trans-generational organization and ruled early Song verse for forty years

The underground line from Xikun to Jiangxi: Huang Tingjian's method of allusion, 'turning iron into gold,' descends directly from Li's reworking of allusion, yet the Jiangxi school publicly honors Du Fu — true transmission often runs off the visible line

The modern parallel of founding a school by text alone, as Turing by paper or Heidegger by lecture-hall-free writings — thinkers with no position of power completing trans-generational organization by the finish of their texts
modern_applications_zh: '以作品开派'的个人战略：不追求职位与头衔，把一门独有能力封装进可模仿的形式（可复用的模板、可学习的体例）——文本自带接口，传灯自动发生
接受'被浅层模仿'的阶段：自己的方法被简化使用时不必焦虑——模仿期是扩散的必经阶段，深层的范式掌握者自会浮现
把'范式'而非'风格'留成遗产：总结自己处理某类问题的完整范式（识别-应对-交付）并公开——风格会过时，处理问题的范式会被人带走继续用
modern_applications_en: Founding a school by work: seek neither office nor title; package one unique capacity into an imitable form (reusable templates, learnable structures) — a text with its own interface, and transmission lights itself
Accepting the phase of shallow imitation: when your method is used simplified, be not anxious — the imitative phase is diffusion's necessary stage, and the masters of the deep paradigm will surface

Leaving a paradigm, not a style, as legacy: distill your complete way of handling a class of problems (identify-respond-deliver) and publish it — styles date; paradigms are carried off and kept in use
